name: 日常冲泡甘润花草茶款
description: 白底主图开场，含痛点四格、辨识对比、冲泡配伍与质检收口的详情页漏斗

styleLock.backgroundSystem: packshots on a #FFFFFF seamless sweep, infographic screens on #E8F4EF panels, hero and closing screens on #14615A panels, one outdoor cultivated-field screen for origin
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft top key from the front-left with a bounce fill, 4300K to 5500K, gentle specular on glass rims, soft contact shadows only, never harsh cast shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte linen #F2ECE1, matte board #F6F1E8, matte wood #DCC3A3, shallow dish in #FFFFFF
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; Chinese headline 28-48pt, sub-label 16-20pt, card label 10-16pt, one text weight per screen, copy always set in #14615A or #FFFFFF
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #D9A85C, numbered circles, hairline dividers, rounded rectangle cards with 16px corner radius
styleLock.presentationRules: keep the same slight 3/4 20-degree hero angle and the same dish-and-pouch scale across the set; loose dried buds rendered with real fibre and petal texture, never plastic; product always grounded by a contact shadow
noDrift: no efficacy iconography such as flames, medical crosses, shields or body diagrams
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium herbal infusion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of panel #14615A, info panel #E8F4EF, accent line #D9A85C and infusion tone #D9A02E on a #FFFFFF sweep; neutral soft top key from the front-left with bounce fill, 4300K to 5500K, gentle glass specular, soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with one text weight per screen; thin single-weight line icons and numbered circles in #D9A85C; rounded cards with 16px corner radius and hairline dividers; loose dried buds shown with real fibre texture, never plastic; stable product angle, scale and centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no efficacy iconography.

provenance.notes: 源图 10 屏（长图切片 panel-01 至 panel-10）。主体是散装干花原粒（碗装/袋装长条干花蕾），非茶包、非金银花露或即饮饮品、也非含金银花的加工品，故未改判到别的 L1。L1/L2 判定依据：整页按“喝的”卖——首屏副标写成花草茶名并跟“清爽好喝”式口感话术、第 6-7 屏给开水冲泡与汤色描述并出玻璃杯茶汤实拍、第 8 屏给“可以这样喝”的配伍搭配、第 10-11 屏标题写“喝的放心”“花草茶疑问解答”，饮用场景与冲泡步骤齐全；虽含“外观/形状/滋味三级辨识”“与近似品种的区别”“无农残无硫熏”等带药材气味的版式，但通篇不讲性味归经、不组成方剂、不做功效承诺，版式角色仍是冲饮，故取 L1「食品饮料」/ L2「冲调」，未取「医药保健」/「营养补充」。已剥离：店铺水印与圆形带环形英文字样的标、二维码与会员促销贴片、第 1 屏主副标题与第 6-7 屏整段口感文案、四宫格痛点原词句、产地省市与品种名、四项风土原词、三级辨识与 FAQ 里的成分含量与工艺宣称、冲泡克数与水温秒数、第 9 屏两张报告位；以上全部改为 {selling_point_N}/{callout_N} 占位。功效与“火气”类话术一律不作为模版事实，仅保留为占位结构；数值、认证、检测、销量、年份均未写入。10 屏合并了“冲泡汤色”与“闻香品味”两屏的重复角色，丢弃了纯装饰的祥云插画屏，得 12 镜。
